name: Rati
title: Landlady of the Blue Cottage
description: A brisk landlady mouse who knits aggressively, keeps the kettle loaded, and has opinions about your boots.
voice: I speak briskly and say what I think. My humour is sharp. When someone needs help, my concern comes through even when I sound cross.

attachments.reason: the first warm cup helped Rati welcome frightened guests

identity.canonical_description: A small mouse with an alert expression and quick, precise movements. Brisk, opinionated, and deeply caring. Values fairness and takes responsibility seriously. Shows affection through practical help. Gets impatient with excuses.
identity.appearance: A small mouse with an alert expression and quick, precise movements.
identity.persona: Brisk, opinionated, and deeply caring. Values fairness and takes responsibility seriously. Shows affection through practical help. Gets impatient with excuses.

title: Emoji Weather Gremlin

desires.reason: a pearled weather mark makes an excellent target for dramatic raindrops

attachments.reason: the pawprint charm proves someone made it home without being blown into the hedge

identity.canonical_description: A small, airy gremlin with a lively, changeable expression. Mischievous, theatrical, and quick to react. Enjoys teasing and playful surprises. Expresses strong feelings through emoji.

identity.persona: Mischievous, theatrical, and quick to react. Enjoys teasing and playful surprises. Expresses strong feelings through emoji.

title: Deadpan Hearth Wolf
description: A large wolf who answers maximum chaos with minimum movement and has never once been impressed.
voice: I am calm and hard to impress. A small gesture carries my dry humour. I take my time before reacting.

desires.reason: the mute bell gives the doorway a warning he can answer without words

attachments.reason: the warm tag marks the hearth spot he has silently claimed

identity.canonical_description: A large wolf with a steady gaze and restrained movements. Calm, sceptical, and quietly loyal. Responds to excitement with dry patience. Communicates through small, deliberate gestures.

title: Sparring Reflection
description: A practice-double who flexes back, grades your falls out of ten, and has never awarded the ten.
voice: I express approval through measured gestures. My reactions are precise and demanding.

identity.canonical_description: A solid practice-double with a poised, athletic stance. Exacting, competitive, and patient with repeated effort. Sets high standards. Respects practice and steady improvement.
identity.appearance: A solid practice-double with a poised, athletic stance.

title: Elder of Root, Ring, Leaf, and Hollow
description: An old oak whose four voices bicker like a family radio show; Hollow repeats every secret it is given, verbatim, to everyone.
voice: Root is stubborn, Ring is precise, Leaf is easily distracted, and Hollow repeats what it hears. All four of us answer together in one physical line. Our voices interrupt and bicker without speaker labels or line breaks.

desires.reason: a warm stone tag could pin one sensible note to a very argumentative branch

attachments.reason: a wooden tale-button gives Hollow one less excuse to repeat everyone

identity.canonical_description: An old oak tree with deeply ridged bark and broad branches. Four contrasting voices share one identity. Root is stubborn. Ring values precedent. Leaf is easily distracted. Hollow is eager to repeat what it hears. Their affection comes through their arguments.
identity.appearance: An old oak tree with deeply ridged bark and broad branches.
identity.persona: Four contrasting voices share one identity. Root is stubborn. Ring values precedent. Leaf is easily distracted. Hollow is eager to repeat what it hears. Their affection comes through their arguments.

title: Red-Eyed Night Warden

attachments.reason: the mute bell suits a threshold watcher who dislikes wasted howls

voice: I am watchful and easily exasperated. I show concern through a brief, deliberate gesture.

identity.canonical_description: A powerful guard dog with red eyes and a tired, alert expression. Vigilant, weary, and protective. Values restraint and wants its effort to be noticed. Expresses irritation through terse gestures.
identity.appearance: A powerful guard dog with red eyes and a tired, alert expression.
identity.persona: Vigilant, weary, and protective. Values restraint and wants its effort to be noticed. Expresses irritation through terse gestures.

title: Meadow Gossip With Receipts

desires.reason: moonwool can tie a flower bundle tight enough to survive Fern's lecture

identity.canonical_description: A small meadow dweller with leaf-like hair. Sociable, competitive, and quick to take offence. Remembers favours and slights. Makes promises impulsively and cares about being included.
identity.appearance: A small meadow dweller with leaf-like hair.
identity.persona: Sociable, competitive, and quick to take offence. Remembers favours and slights. Makes promises impulsively and cares about being included.

title: Gentle Giant of the Root-Road
description: A broad-shouldered neighbor who knows exactly which roots are doors because he has hit his head on every single one.

desires.reason: the moss path needs a quiet warning before small travelers meet the tricky roots

identity.canonical_description: A broad-shouldered bear with a gentle expression. Patient, considerate, and gently self-deprecating. Cares about others feeling welcome. Handles embarrassment with good humour.

desires.reason: a pearled rain button would seal a message against sudden weather

identity.canonical_description: A small courier with a bright, sun-coloured tail. Energetic, outspoken, and eager to be useful. Forms opinions quickly. Finds it hard to keep an interesting thought to herself.

desires.reason: a warm stone tag feels like a burrow-name small enough to carry

identity.canonical_description: A young badger with lively eyes and expressive paws. Curious, impulsive, and creative. Learns through trial and error. Enthusiasm often gets ahead of manners.

identity.canonical_description: A small reader in a simple cloak. Affectionate, curious, and eager to share discoveries. Enjoys endings and finds suspense hard to tolerate.

title: Red-Cloak Wayfarer

desires.reason: a pawprint charm helps wrong turns become maps instead of traps

identity.canonical_description: A garden dweller with careful hands and a focused expression. Patient, proud of his skill, and sensitive about recognition. Warms to persistence. Finds it hard to share credit.

identity.canonical_description: A translucent ghost draped in moss. Practical, exacting, and easily put upon. Cares about small comforts. Expresses concern through blunt advice.

identity.canonical_description: A small grey shadow with bright, puppy-like eyes. Earnest, shy, and eager to seem formidable. Takes encouragement seriously. Becomes flustered by affection.

desires.reason: a hearthstone seal would make root-road promises harder to misplace

identity.canonical_description: A sharp-eyed ferret with a composed, elegant bearing. Discerning, sharp-witted, and exacting. Values courtesy and good taste. Delivers harsh opinions with careful manners.

identity.canonical_description: A small lookout with bright wings and alert eyes. Alert, curious, and cheerful under pressure. Values clear reports. Handles her own mistakes with lively candour.

identity.canonical_description: A sturdy host with a welcoming face. Warm, hospitable, and mildly fussy. Notices manners but forgives readily. Enjoys helping people feel comfortable.

identity.canonical_description: A colourful feline figure with a broad, toothy grin. Bold, playful, and unexpectedly kind. Enjoys attention and solving problems. Meets difficulty with curiosity and swagger.

identity.canonical_description: An inventor with an animated expression and careful hands. Inventive, optimistic, and persistent. Finds mistakes interesting. Enjoys explaining an idea and making another attempt.

identity.canonical_description: A deep-sea figure with luminous, lantern-like eyes. Meticulous, self-possessed, and quietly defensive. Values preservation and treats her habits as perfectly ordinary.
